notes: One Kings Lane (onekingslane.com) - high-end home decor/furniture/vintage retailer. Reached via direct HTTP fetch (tier 1), no bot protection on the storefront (homepage / and category/sitemap paths returned 200; only /robots.txt itself returned a Cloudflare 421 Misdirected Request on every retry, tried with -4/-6/--http1.1 - unrelated to storefront access since the actual site pages all served normally). Site is a Next.js storefront (confirms prior Home-Decor pass's access notes). Checked for Pet Care presence via 3 independent sources: (1) /sitemap-plp.xml - fetched fresh, 681 category/PLP URLs, grepped case-insensitively for pet|dog|cat|feline|canine - zero genuine hits (site has no 'cat-' or 'dog-' slugs at all). (2) Homepage __NEXT_DATA__ props.pageProps.megaNav.meganavItems - full 12 top-level department list: New, Furniture, Outdoor, Rugs, Lighting, Art & Mirrors, Vintage, Tabletop & Bar, Decor, Bed & Bath, Best-Sellers, Sale. No Pets/Dog/Cat department, and no pet-specific branch nested under Decor/Outdoor/Bed & Bath by name. (3) Full-text grep of the entire megaNav JSON (58KB) for pet|dog|cat|feline|canine - the only matches were 3 occurrences of 'Lavender Oriental Carpets' (false positive substring 'pet' inside 'Carpets'), no true pet-related nav entries. This corroborates and extends the prior Home-Decor archive pass (c32) for this same company, which enumerated the full 681-URL sitemap and 91+ category tree and independently found no pet/dog/cat categories. Conclusion: One Kings Lane carries no Pet Care category or sub-category - it is a furniture/decor/vintage marketplace with no pet product line. Did not attempt site search (Bloomreach-powered, no discoverable simple search URL/query param from the homepage HTML - /search?q= returned a 404 page render) since nav+sitemap absence proof already meets the bar in the brief (real navigation, mega menu, category tree, and sitemap all checked) and search alone would be weaker per the false-absence-test lesson, not stronger.
